Walk-in-Interview for appointing Guest Faculty in Commerce
Walk-in-Interview for the appointment of Guest Faculty in the Subject of
Commerce for the academic session 2023-2024 will be held on 30.08.2023 at Rajiv Gandhi
College Bhawan, Panjab University, Chandigarh at 02:30 PM.
The eligible candidates are required to report in the Committee Room, Rajiv
Gandhi College Bhawan, Panjab University, Chandigarh at 01:00 PM on 30.08.2023 for the
verification of applications/documents.

All the applicants (who are eligible as per UGC/PU norms are advised to bring their
original certificates and other relevant documents including publications with photo
copies of certificates and 02 passport photographs) for verification along with duly filled
forms giving the details at the time of interview.
No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
The application forms for the post of Assistant Professor is available at website
(http://jobs.puchd.ac.in/forms.php).
The candidates shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any
fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till they are teaching at
Baba Balraj Panjab University Constituent College, Balachaur.
